game_name: Dungeons & Dragons: Shadow over Mystara (USA 960619 Phoenix Edition) (bootleg)
general_issues: Select ddsomud.zip; keep parent archives, keys and required qsound.zip beside it. Experimental emulation; profile coverage does not mean full gameplay qualification. Press Test to release the startup Test switch when navigating a boot-time operator screen. TPO automatically assigns up to 4 computers. Each computer controls one player on the shared cabinet using its Player 1 controls. Rollback uses a canonical two-frame input delay; every linked cabinet and serial queue is restored together. Offline EEPROM and manual cabinet settings are ignored during online play.
